codeSystems.name: HeartlandEvidenceLevel
codeSystems.title: HEARTLAND Evidence Level
codeSystems.description: Three-tiered transparency labels distinguishing evidence strength behind HEARTLAND Protocol v3.2 recommendations, helping clinicians calibrate clinical decisions.

codeSystems.name: HeartlandImplementationTier
codeSystems.title: HEARTLAND Implementation Tier
codeSystems.description: Declared facility implementation capacity tiers, retaining historical code identities. Capacity informs delivery format, sequence and support; it does not determine clinical eligibility, permit delayed risk-led care or exclude educational domains. All eight domains are offered at every tier. These labels are not a scored readiness instrument or proof of actual coverage.

codeSystems.name: HeartlandMonitoringTrack
codeSystems.title: HEARTLAND Monitoring Track
codeSystems.description: Documented monitoring routes with stable Track A and Track B codes. A route does not establish equivalent outcomes, successful contact, device availability or completed monitoring. Clinical requirements are not reduced by the route; access, preference and the supported local plan require separate documentation.

codeSystems.name: HeartlandRiskScore
codeSystems.title: HEARTLAND Risk Score Codes
codeSystems.description: Codes identifying the HEARTLAND risk score and its tier when either is carried on an Observation rather than on a RiskAssessment — for example an Observation referenced from HeartlandRiskAssessment.basis holding the point total. The score is a non-validated implementation heuristic: the total is a point count, not a probability, and the tier assigns monitoring intensity rather than predicting an outcome.

codeSystems.name: HeartlandRiskTier
codeSystems.title: HEARTLAND Risk Tier
codeSystems.description: Qualitative risk stratification tiers from the HEARTLAND Protocol v3.2 risk score (0-18 points). Used in HeartlandRiskAssessment.prediction.qualitativeRisk.
